title: Polynomial-Time Computability of Unary Multiplication
statement: Encode pairs by doubling each bit of the first component, appending $01$, and then the second component, and decode inputs by reading aligned pairs, with empty strings as defaults when decoding fails. Starting from the encoding of the first decoded component of the input paired with the encoding of its second decoded component paired with the empty string, iterate the update that preserves the first component and appends it to the second component exactly $|z|+1$ times; then take the second component twice from the resulting nested pair. The resulting function is polynomial-time computable.
